_comment: Every string this mod puts in front of a player. Merged into locales.global.<lang> for every language the database carries -- English text in every language beats a raw key showing through on a loading screen, and it is what upstream does.
_keying: The map screen does NOT print `Base.Name`. `LocationInfoPanel` localises `(location._Id + " Name")` and `(location._Id + " Description")`, so the two keys below are built from the slot's OBJECT id at load and are not written out here. `{slot}` is substituted with that object id and `{name}` / `{description}` with the config's display strings.
_bare: The bare slot name, which several older UI paths still look up directly.
_exits: One per exit `Name` in exits.json. Without an entry the extraction panel renders the raw exit id, underscores and all -- and renaming the exit is not an option, because that name is the key the panel, the exfil controller and the raid-end ExitName all match on. The self-test checks this list against exits.json in both directions.
_banners: The loading-screen banner captions. The images themselves are not served -- this ABI has no static-file route -- but a banner with a caption and no picture degrades to the default art with a caption, which is better than a broken image.
_zones: The bot zone the waves in waves.json spawn into. Named here so the in-raid compass and any quest that references a zone reads as a place rather than as an identifier.
